replies.content: In the Netherlands it should work the same as what you're used to. Which makes sense because it's based on EU regulation. We have the EPD (Electronisch Patiënten Dossier), a central registry that should contain your medical information and history. Access is only allowed after your approval, because the subject is the owner of the data (though some medical professionals and institutions don't seem to understand this).

I think you're mixing two things up. You've heard that the central health authority doesn't have access to all the data of who is being vaccinated, which is true. But that does not mean that vaccinations aren't being recorded. Every vaccination is recorded by the organisation who carries it out, but there's a ton of organisations/people carrying out vaccinations right now and they all record it on their own system. And that system is not synced with the system the national health authority uses. I believe they're working on linking them, though it's taking a long time. But because it's unworkable to manually record vaccinations carried out by every GP, every nursing home, every group home, etc in the whole country they use the estimate for now. Once the systems are connected most of the info will be available to the national health authority as well, and I assume your GP would get a record too if you haven't been vaccinated there. Like other countries we also have that booklet where your vaccinations are recorded, but I'm not sure if they intend to add COVID vaccinations to that as well. I think they're still working that out.
Works the same here. Had to give my ok to my gp the last time I went there. Now even my dentist was able to see what I've been up to medically.

I am surprise and confused with this as well and no matter how many places I have called/contacted (GP&GGD etc.) I could not get any information because no body really knows what is going on in terms of covid-19 vaccine registrations. I am in high risk group because of my medical condition and I wanted to make sure that whoever checks these things can see that information so I get my vaccination as soon as possible. But I found out that there is no way to check this because they do not have a central data system so these ''authorities'' cannot obtain your medical information efficiently. This is absurd in my opinion because without such an information how are they going to categorise people as high risk and send an invitation for vaccination. I guess there are trying to solve this but I am not sure how that's going to happen.

Hi there and welcome to the Netherlands 🇳🇱 TLDR: How it works here: The home doctor or GGD registrars a person to a batch of vaccin, if you develop complications you report to your home doctor or GGD. They report to the LAREB and they report to the EMA. +++ There was a time ago that we only had a "yellow passport" for all of our vaccinations. Due to the fact "dutchies" like to travel a lot, this was a good business model. Our government and doctors told us to get them all. Almost every home doctor had his own travel vaccin business 🤣 and you could buy all, not covered, normally, by your insurance. This was even a good business for a while 😉 In general the politics opinion is that patients carry there own information. You, as a patient in the Netherlands, have the right to be silent about your medical history. This is a very important fundamental pillar for laws like WGBO etc. Assuming this protect the patient against the practitioner. To answer your last question about a general registration first A daily use case: (fictionally spoken) I'm a politian, I like to fuck around, I have 8 female assistants. One of them gets a STD all of them gets STD. So I get a nice treatment. Long story short: If this treatment and all meds info was generally located and stored, I could login to check, but also my (house)wife. This is a privacy leak they want to avoid😏 But how in emergency cases: If you are unconscious. You have the basic principle s like : - treat first what kills first - do not further harm - ask AMPLE (allergy, medication, part, last meal, expose) this can be asked to some else. In general we have highly skilled paramedics/nurses and docs on the ER and ambulance. You might notice a paramedic on ambulance in a hurry by saying this: "Diesel (fuel) is the only medication you need right now" This means : we have to go to the hospital ASAP 🏥
